summary: Steven Madden, Ltd. filed an 8-K on May 6, 2026, reporting its first-quarter fiscal 2026 financial results and announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per share payable June 19, 2026 to holders of record June 8, 2026. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 with Items 2.02 and 8.01. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration filing, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, strategic review, tender, restructuring, liquidation, spin-off, or other special-situation event is present. The filing is purely operational/financial disclosure with a regular dividend.
